description: Ministry of Public Administration - Service Minute of the Management Service Officers Service - Amendment No.04.
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to amendments to the Service Minute of the Management Service Officers Service, specifically concerning educational qualifications for recruitment. This falls under public sector administration, service conditions, and recruitment regulations, which is the definition of a Public Service Gazette (Type 8). It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) or any of the other specialized categories like Land, Legal, Commercial, etc.
